watches.name: core-add
targets: features/add-todo.feature:Creating a new todo from text input

watches.name: visibility
targets: features/visibility.feature:Main and footer are hidden when no todos exist
features/visibility.feature:Main and footer appear when a todo is added

watches.name: toggle
targets: features/toggle-todo.feature:Checking a todo marks it completed
features/toggle-todo.feature:Unchecking a todo marks it active

watches.name: toggle-all
targets: features/toggle-all.feature:Toggling all marks every todo as completed
features/toggle-all.feature:Unchecking toggle-all marks every todo as active
features/toggle-all.feature:Toggle-all is unchecked when any todo is active

watches.name: counter
targets: features/counter.feature:Counter shows the count of active todos
features/counter.feature:Counter uses plural form for multiple items
features/counter.feature:Counter uses singular form for one item

watches.name: clear-completed
targets: features/clear-completed.feature:Clear completed button is hidden when no todos are completed
features/clear-completed.feature:Clear completed button is visible when todos are completed

watches.name: filtering
targets: features/filtering.feature:Active filter shows only incomplete todos
features/filtering.feature:Completed filter shows only completed todos
features/filtering.feature:Completing a todo hides it from the Active filter
features/filtering.feature:Active filter is selected by default

watches.name: persistence
targets: features/persistence.feature:Todos are stored under the correct localStorage key

watches.name: routing
targets: features/routing.feature:Clicking a filter link changes the route
